name: The Hollow Archive
description:
About This Game


About the Game

Dungeons? Not in My Contract! is an anime-style action roguelike being developed in Unreal Engine.

Nefret has just landed a job as a rookie librarian. On her very first night shift, a mysterious old woman hands her a book, and the moment she opens it, she is pulled into the world inside.

Waiting for her there are strange worlds, each with its own myths and stories, and the dangers she must face to find her way back.

Even after making it back to the library, she can’t relax just yet. A nagging head librarian and an employment contract that keeps getting worse are waiting for her.

Will Nefret survive her very first job?

Features

Slash, Dodge, Smash.
A hyper-action roguelike set in book worlds where myths come alive.
Cut through waves of enemy attacks, switch weapons, and build your own combos.
Fall in battle, open the book again, and the fight begins anew.

Open a Book, Begin a New Adventure
From Egypt’s sun god to the demons of Journey to the West and the Wizard of Oz.
Every book holds a completely different world, with its own enemies and bosses.
Explore unfamiliar myths, make different choices every run, and discover your own way to fight.

From Storybook Allies to Library Coworkers
The NPCs you rescue inside the books join the real-world library as staff.
The companions you meet on your adventures become your coworkers, bringing new stories to library life.
The more dangerous books you return from, the livelier the library becomes.

Never a Quiet Moment
Lapi, a cat who never stops talking, even in the middle of combat, fights alongside Nefret.
Is it encouragement or nagging? Either way, Nefret sighs once again.
Even when her life is on the line, their conversations rarely end the way you’d expect.

About This Game

Early Access

We are aiming to launch in Early Access in Q4 2026.

During Early Access, we plan to listen to your feedback and continue refining the combat and content.

A free demo will be released in October 2026.
After playing, please let us know what you enjoyed and what you think could be better.

Anything from moments in combat that felt uncomfortable, to instructions that were hard to follow, to content you’d like to see more of. Your feedback will go a long way toward making the game better.

FAQ

Q. When is the full release?
We are aiming for Q1 2027.
We will share more details about development progress and the release schedule later.

Q. Can I play with a controller?
Controller support is planned for the full release.

Q. What will change in the full version?
We plan to expand the book worlds you can explore, the weapons, and the reward choices you encounter during play.
Based on your feedback, we will also improve the UI and overall usability, and optimize performance for a smoother experience.

AI Disclosure

Some content in this game was created with the help of AI generation tools.
All such content was reviewed and edited by the development team before being included in the game.
short_desc: Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.
